parsed_design.design_rationale: Bilaterally symmetric double-parallelogram with central rigid output. Four identical leaf flexures along X (L~45mm, h=1.0mm, b=10mm) give low Y stiffness k~600N/m for dy~8mm at 5N, stress ~17MPa <25MPa, while X stiffness and rotational stiffness are orders higher, suppressing dx and theta. Symmetry cancels parasitic motion.
